Class SwerveDriveConfig<T extends SwerveDriveConfig<T>>

java.lang.Object
yams.core.mechanisms.config.SwerveDriveConfig<T>
Type Parameters:
T - Concrete config type, so chained with calls keep the subclass type.
Direct Known Subclasses:
SwerveDriveConfig, SwerveDriveConfig
public abstract class SwerveDriveConfig<T extends SwerveDriveConfig<T>> extends Object
Swerve Drive Configuration.

Holds modules, gyro supplier, and drive controllers. Modules are ordered clockwise from front-left: FL, FR, BL, BR. See SwerveDriveConfig for the Subsystem-bound subclass and a full construction example.

    • withAntiTipping

      public T withAntiTipping(org.wpilib.units.measure.LinearVelocity kP, org.wpilib.units.measure.Angle tippingThreshold, org.wpilib.units.measure.LinearVelocity maxCorrectionSpeed)
      Drive the robot back under itself when it starts to tip, with WPILib's AntiTipping: once the robot's pitch or roll, from the gyro set with withGyro(Supplier), is past tippingThreshold, a correction toward the side it is tipping to, kP times the sine of the tilt and at most maxCorrectionSpeed, is added to every robot relative chassis speed. See AntiTipping for tuning.
      Parameters:
      kP - Correction speed per sine of the tilt.
      tippingThreshold - Tilt past which to correct: a few degrees above the most the robot tilts in normal driving, well below where it tips.
      maxCorrectionSpeed - Fastest the correction may drive.
      Returns:
      SwerveDriveConfig for chaining.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if kP or maxCorrectionSpeed is not positive, or tippingThreshold is not between 0 and 90 degrees.

    • withModuleStateOptimization

      public T withModuleStateOptimization(boolean enabled)
      Enable or disable state optimization on every SwerveModule of the drive, overriding each module's SwerveModuleConfig.withOptimization(boolean). Without this override, each module keeps its own setting.

      Modules already in this config are updated immediately, so calling this on a running drive's config (e.g. drive.getConfig().withModuleStateOptimization(false)) toggles optimization during operation. Modules added later with withModules(SwerveModule...) get it when the SwerveDrive is created.

      Parameters:
      enabled - True to let modules turn around and reverse their drive when that is the shorter way to the requested angle, false to always steer to the requested angle.
      Returns:
      SwerveDriveConfig for chaining.
